subject.title: [Bug]: Session event broadcasts rebuild full gateway session rows

question: Should the remaining fix path stay with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86793 after rebase/proof, or should maintainers close that PR if fresh profiling shows adjacent fixes made it unnecessary?
rationale: The issue is still source-reproducible on current main, but the active fix changes session-state event shape and the linked PR is conflicting and missing real behavior proof.

options.title: Repair and prove the linked PR
options.body: Rebase the lightweight snapshot approach onto current main, preserve scoped row loading, and require redacted runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Close the linked PR after fresh profiling
options.body: If a current-main gateway profile shows the reported cost is gone, close the linked PR and then close this issue with the profiling evidence.

options.title: Keep tracking without a PR
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical tracker while asking for a new narrower implementation if the current branch is not worth repairing.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove the linked PR
recommendation.body: Rebase the lightweight snapshot approach onto current main, preserve scoped row loading, and require redacted runtime proof before merge.
